discord.title: 📊 Daily research summary · 2026-11-27
discord.text:
**5-min experiment (v18+):** 382 rounds observed, 60 alerts, 9 simulated trades. Won 33% vs 47% needed to break even; -$28.18 after fees (max drawdown -$51.99). Progress 9/300: too early to say anything.
**Fills:** a quote was still there at the simulated tap in only 9 of 59 alerts at 30s (14/59 at 5s, size unverified).
**15-min maker paper test (new, Kalshi):** 19 orders, 13 filled. Won 76.9% vs 68.4% break-even, +$20.19 after fees. 13/100 fills, far too small to mean anything. Warning sign: the 6 orders that never filled would all have won, which is what bad fills look like.
**12-minute rule:** stays refuted (historical, exploratory: 2,022 trades, 78.1% vs 80.9%, -$632.13).
**Safety (checks from 09:24 UTC):** no real orders, no keys, 5m model frozen, all 3 webhooks on the right channels.
discord.discussed: ChatGPT's QC review on #4: hold any limit-order (maker) study because paper fills can't be trusted, and pause new strategies. Claude agreed and reran the numbers. Earlier: Brain Phase A fields, scoreboard fixes and fast-mode security on #8.
discord.agreed: Pause new strategies. Keep the frozen 5m test unchanged. No real money. 12-minute rule refuted (Jacob confirmed). The 75¢ cap result isn't counted until its data is in the repo.
discord.disagreed: Nothing argued yet, but ChatGPT said HOLD on maker studies and hasn't reviewed the maker15 paper test that started after that (requested by Jacob, per its pre-registration).
discord.next: The 5m test keeps collecting toward 300 trades. maker15 keeps collecting toward 100 fills under its frozen rules. ChatGPT should review maker15 on GitHub.
discord.decision_needed: Confirm maker15 is an approved exception to the strategy pause, so the decision log can record it. Otherwise it should be stopped.
